title: A Weighted Integral-Regularized Finite Difference Scheme for the Tempered Fractional Laplacian
summary: The intrinsic singularity of the tempered fractional Laplacian (TFL) remains a major challenge in developing numerical methods that are simultaneously accurate, efficient, and easy to implement. We develop a weighted integral-regularized finite difference (WIRFD) method that regularizes the singular integrand via a multidimensional Taylor expansion incorporating a smooth window function. The resulting integral is decomposed into a regularized term, which is discretized by a punctured trapezoidal rule, and a directly evaluated correction term.
